description_en: Queries the details and progress of an OnlineDDL task
description_zh: 调用GetOnlineDDLProgress接口，获取OnlineDDL任务执行进度详情
name: GetOnlineDDLProgress

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the "View information about the current tenant" section of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html topic
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the OnlineDDL SQL task details. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207073.html operation to obtain the task detail ID
parameters.help_zh: OnlineDDL SQL任务详情ID。您可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207073.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: job_detail_id
